relevance_note: Family series of 8 HA20 patients carrying TNFAIP3 c.259C>T; three are described individually: "23-year-old twin sisters (P5, P6) and a 70-year-old grandmother (P1)".
method_note: Read the full HAL author manuscript by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON. Scope: the paper reports 8 affected women of one family carrying c.259C>T p.(Arg87*), but only P1, P5 and P6 are described individually; the other five carriers (labels never printed; Figure 1 pedigree and Supplementary Table 1 are not in the text) appear only as counts (e.g. aphthous ulcers 8/8, arthralgia 3/8, pericarditis 1/8, autoimmune features 6/8) and get no rows. Unaffected family members who tested negative are described only as a group, no rows. Literature patients: of the 12 previously published patients with liver involvement (Supplementary Table 2, not available), only the ref 7 (Takagi et al.) and ref 14 patients get an individual-level fact (liver histology) and were given rows; the two refs 6,15 patients share a joint citation and their histology cannot be attributed, so no rows. No variant rows for literature patients (no variant printed for them). Group statements used: 'None had uveitis' (all 8) -> uveitis excluded but the composite checklist item 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation' left not reported; '8 patients ... with heterozygous mutations' -> zygosity heterozygous; 'all women' / 'twin sisters' / 'grandmother' -> female; liver-biopsy statements about all biopsies of P1, P5 and P6 (sinusoidal infiltrate, no cholestasis); the work-up excluding autoimmune causes of chronic hepatic cytolysis in the three patients -> autoimmune hepatitis excluded (inferred from group statement). Ages '70-year-old' and '23-year-old' recorded as age at last evaluation (stated in the Results as current ages; the abstract says 'aged 23 and 70 years'). P1 'Portal tracts were either normal (P1)' not recorded as an excluded feature: it is ambiguous given P1's documented portal inflammation and interface hepatitis. P6 'too small to definitively confirm cirrhosis' not recorded. P1 gastric biopsy 'consistent with a diagnosis of pernicious anemia' kept as detail only; pernicious anemia, type I diabetes, Hashimoto thyroiditis and ANA are reported only as cohort counts. Variant type not recorded: the Discussion's 'nonsense or frameshift mutations ... as in our patients' lists several values. Inheritance not recorded (pedigree only). The Markdown renders '>' as '>'; spans keep '>' verbatim while variant values use 'c.259C>T'. Figure 4 legend (P6) gives rectal mucosal ulceration although the Results describe ileal biopsies; both recorded as observed, no contradiction. No internal contradictions found.
